mentions.name: Consumer-industry disruption app concept
mentions.description: An app in the early brainstorming stage that aims to disrupt an incumbent, outdated industry whose legacy practices are seen as detrimental to consumers. No specific features or domain have been decided yet.
mentions.problem: The incumbent industry is outdated, and its old practices are detrimental to consumers.
mentions.audience: Consumers harmed by the industry's outdated practices
mentions.source_excerpt: I am brainstorming an App to disrupt an incumbent and quite frankly outdated industry with old practices that are detrimental to consumers.

evidence.value: I am brainstorming an App to disrupt an incumbent and quite frankly outdated industry with old practices that are detrimental to consumers.
evidence.author: Quinzel
